description_for_human: ML predictions for materials: formation energy, band gap, stability, XRD, battery/PV/catalysis verticals via M3GNet/MEGNet/CHGNet/OMat24.
description_for_model: MatGraph is a materials-informatics CLI/SDK/GraphQL. Tools: predict(formula, model), substitute, xrd, stability, bands, elastic, dielectric, magnetic, vertical(battery|catalysis|pv|thermo|2d|alloy|defect), finetune, benchmark. Uses pymatgen + matgl + mp-api. Provenance + cache. Install: pip install matgraph-cli. Requires MP_API_KEY env.
